name: Cypress Cloud
description:
Connect Cypress Cloud to Claude to give your AI agent a real-time window into your application's health and stability. Claude can fetch CI run statuses, identify flaky tests, and retrieve detailed failure data—including stack traces and Test Replay links—directly within your workflow. By bridging the context gap between CI and your editor, you can eliminate manual triage and resolve test failures faster.

Access your Cypress Cloud data in real-time, directly in Claude. Claude can fetch run details, identify failed and flaky tests, retrieve detailed test data, like stack traces and Test Replay links and more. Run maintenance triage workflows, build reporting and execute test remediation faster.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cypress Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cypress Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cypress.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cypress Cloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cypress Cloud provides these MCP tools: cypress_get_accessibility_report, cypress_get_accessibility_rule_failures, cypress_get_accessibility_views, cypress_get_failed_tests, cypress_get_flaky_tests, cypress_get_projects, cypress_get_runs, cypress_get_ui_coverage_elements, cypress_get_ui_coverage_report, cypress_get_ui_coverage_views, cypress_make_shareable_test_replay, and submit_mcp_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cypress Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cypress Cloud in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Cypress Cloud MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cypress Cloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cypress Cloud is developed by Cypress.io. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
